title: Warm Glazed American Chicken Skillet
description: A tender and flavorful solo dinner dish featuring natural yoghurt and a lacquer glaze, perfect for a low glycemic diet. This mustardy chicken skillet is a delicious and healthy option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yoghurt, Dijon mustard, honey, apple cider vinegar, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Brush the yoghurt mixture evenly over the cooked chicken.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer the chicken in the yoghurt glaze for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and serve with additional glaze if desired.
